name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Daniel Obajtek
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided to lift the legal protection that Daniel Obajtek, a Polish member of the Parliament, holds as an elected representative. Polish prosecutors want to charge him over two contracts worth about 394,000 zloty, signed in 2021 when he ran the company PKN ORLEN. They say the contracts served his private interests and harmed the company. Lifting his protection lets the Polish case go ahead. The Parliament found no sign that the case was brought to damage his political work.

- Polish prosecutors can now pursue criminal proceedings against Daniel Obajtek over the two 2021 contracts.
- It affects Daniel Obajtek, a Polish member of the European Parliament, and the Polish court case against him.
- The Parliament's President sends the decision to the Polish authorities and to Obajtek.
